title: American Airlines - Wikipedia
content: Airline of the United States. This article is about the US-based airline named "American Airlines". For a full list of all US-based airlines, see List of airlines of the United States. **American Airlines, Inc.** is a major airline in the United States headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, within the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, and is the largest airline in the world in terms of passengers carried and daily flights. The airline is also a founding member of the Oneworld alliance, one of the world's three major airline alliances. American Airlines and American Eagle operate out of ten hubs, anchored by Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW), the airline's largest. In 2013, American Airlines merged with US Airways but kept the American Airlines name, as it was the better-recognized brand internationally; the combination of the two airlines resulted in the creation of the largest airline in the United States, and ultimately the world.

title: Where we are | The AA
content: ## Our customers span the length and breadth of the UK. We have offices located across the UK from Newcastle to Royal Tunbridge Wells. All of our sites have good road and rail links, meaning getting to our offices couldn’t be easier. And because we’ve prioritised making them modern, light and airy, they’re the perfect places for our teams to come together and collaborate. A lot has changed over the past few years, and here at The AA, we’ve changed too. We’ve all learnt how to adapt to new ways of working, and we’re very proud of what we’ve achieved. We’re constantly evolving and improving how we operate, and we have captured the benefits that new ways of working have given us. Working flexibly between a site or office and home. Woking exclusively on a site or in an office. We believe that combining home and office working where possible drives collaboration and engagement – and reduces the environmental impact of our workplaces.

title: American Airlines Headquarters
content: ## By Type. ## By Location. # The American Airlines campus is an inspiring and unifying home for the world's largest airline. Crandall Campus consists of four buildings with offices subdivided into working villages. American Airlines had a definitive vision for this expansive redevelopment: One Campus, One Team — a singular campus that unites frontline and management teams. The new campus is the central connection point for 130,000 team members worldwide, reflecting the values and aspirations of this iconic company and the forward-looking spirit of aviation. ## Inspiring connections on a grand scale. The Skyview 8 Town Hall is the heart of the campus, offering an uplifting sense of arrival and community. Skyview 8 is a series of four buildings connected by a Town Hall with shared collaborative spaces, dining, and wellness amenities. The “working villages” have an intuitive and interconnected layout that foster spontaneous collaboration and promote equity across working groups. ## More About the Project. ### Project Team. ### Project Information.
